clauses.reason: First end 1955-01-31 (midnight closing that day) by the President's designation in EO 10585, which designates January 31, 1955 as the date of termination of combatant activities in the zone described in EO 10195. The designation of the zone and its commencement date are the order's only commands, and they operate only for the period ending on that date. The held OFR cross-reference lists the instrument date Jan. 1, 1955, which is not the termination date.

research_rationale:
EO 10195 (Dec. 20, 1950; 15 FR 9177) designated Korea and the adjacent waters within stated limits as a combat zone under section 22(b)(13) of the Internal Revenue Code (as amended by the Revenue Act of 1950) and fixed June 27, 1950 as the date combatant activities commenced there. EO 10585 (signed Jan. 1, 1955; 20 FR 17) was issued under section 112(c)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1954 and designates January 31, 1955, as of midnight thereof, as the date of termination of combatant activities in the zone comprised of the area described in EO 10195. The OFR note points to EO 10585 with the signing date Jan. 1, 1955, but that is the date of the instrument; the termination date it designates is January 31, 1955. A combat-zone designation exists only for the period between the commencement date and the termination date, so the designation ended at midnight closing 1955-01-31 (inclusive reading; the exclusive reading is that it ended when Feb. 1, 1955 began). EO 10195 has no own-terms end and no other held instrument revokes or amends it; EO 10585 is the only later instrument naming it. Residual: tax consequences for service within June 27, 1950 to Jan. 31, 1955 accrued and are a surviving effect of the designation rather than a continuing command.

savings.reason: The designation operated for the period June 27, 1950 through the termination date. The tax-exclusion consequences that attached to service in the zone during that period (and the 1952 public law text held in the corpus that defines Korea by reference to EO 10195) are accrued effects of a completed designation. EO 10585 does not cancel them and no held source shows a continuing command in EO 10195.
